g.text: The process harnesses of P9: N2 and the replay across blocks
N2: one deploy set on each racing runtime
with a role variable, one child for each racing runtime
over an in-memory store, at the v6 limits
read the records of the child
certify each record from the empty root
The replay across blocks, on each racing runtime
30, 28 and 28 deploys at the v6 limits
open the store at the pre-state
decode the evidence, check the journal,
bind the trace to the event log
post-state root of the deploy before it
from the empty root, in the parent process
the post-state roots of play, and the deliveries
of each family and of the agent
A record holds the pre-state and post-state roots, the outputs, the event log,
the evidence bytes and the phlo of play. A child prints no test output to the
parent: the parent keeps the standard output of each child.
stored state and the record files
